title: Document completion-driven test execution in the review workflow
outcome: Document completion-driven test execution in the review workflow
acceptance: The parent review command prescribes one logged test runner, completion-triggered waits or bounded worker execution, no model-level polling/status spam, recovery of existing runs, and failure inspection/classification without weakening gates.
The reviewer command remains read-only and does not execute tests; required validation and paired review cover the final documentation change.

completion.summary: Documented completion-driven logged gate execution, completion waits, recovery-before-relaunch and failure classification while preserving all required gates and two read-only reviewer leaves. Final nine gates and combined pair consolidated; independent session-7130 evaluation records 2/2 pass on judgment evidence. No commit or installation.
